## About
Autokrafters of Des Plaines is a full service auto body shop on Golf Road. We handle collision repair on all makes and models, foreign and domestic, along with mechanical work, window and door repairs, dent repair and towing.
Whether it's a fender bender or a major collision, our technicians repair the damage to your car, truck or SUV, match the paint, and keep you up to date on how your vehicle is coming along. We welcome insurance work and offer car rental assistance while your car is with us.
Customers rate us 4.6 from 108 Google reviews. One reviewer said each person who worked here introduced themselves and made them feel at home. Stop by or give us a call, and ask for Ernie.

## Services
- Collision repair: Complete collision repair on all makes and models, foreign and domestic.
- Maintenance and tune-ups: A regular maintenance service or a full tune-up to help prolong the life of your vehicle.
- Window and door mechanical replacement: Mechanical replacement for windows and doors.
- Dent work: Our technicians work dents out to a smooth finish.
- 24-hour towing: Stuck somewhere? Call our 24-hour towing service from wherever you are and we'll get your car to the shop.

## FAQ
Q: Do you give free estimates?
A: Yes. Collision repair estimates are free. Give us a call to set up an appointment.

Q: Do you work with insurance?
A: Yes. We welcome insurance work, whether you've been in a fender bender or a major collision.

Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM.
